cohort: 27 singleton pregnancies with face presentation at term, matched with 108 controls with vertex presentation at the same gestational age and delivery month
finding: High parity and amniotic fluid index > 18 cm were associated with face presentation at term.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean section was higher in the face presentation group compared to the control group (88.9% vs. 13.9%, P < 0.001).
